g.text: What changes when the prompt changes?
The four panels ask: How much does separation improve? How useful is each suggestion on its own? How far do points move? How many suggestions are returned? Higher means
more of the named quantity, not always better. Asking for the worst pair gives fewer suggestions and less total gain, but stronger individual suggestions. Small lines
